verdict.rationale: Airweave documents a Vercel AI SDK package (airweaveSearch tool) and a LlamaIndex tool spec, plus MCP server support that agents like Cursor/Claude Code can use, but there is no first-party documented integration for LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI specifically — the story's named frameworks are only partially covered. missing for 10: documented LangChain integration, documented LangGraph integration, documented CrewAI integration, independent hands-on confirmation of the Vercel AI SDK package working in production.
